title: Password / lockout: my password expired and I can't log in to Windows
steps: Verified identity via employee ID and manager confirmation.
Reset password in Active Directory and set 'change at next logon'.
Explained the history rule: the last 10 passwords cannot be reused.

title: Password / lockout: my account is locked out
steps: Checked lockout source in AD lockout status tool: mobile mail client with stale password.
Unlocked the account.
Asked the user to update the password on the phone mail app, then confirmed no further lockouts.

title: MFA: got a new phone and MFA codes don't work
steps: Verified identity through manager callback.
Revoked the old MFA method and issued a temporary access pass.
Guided user to register Microsoft Authenticator on the new phone and tested a sign-in.

title: MFA: MFA code always says invalid
steps: Found phone clock was 3 minutes off; TOTP codes are time based.
Set phone date and time to automatic.
Code accepted on next attempt.

title: Permission request: need access to the finance shared drive
steps: Obtained data-owner approval in the access request.
Added user to the AD security group for the share.
Asked user to log off and on to refresh group membership; access confirmed.

title: Permission request: missing authorization in SAP for transaction
steps: Ran SU53 to capture the failed authorization object.
Raised role change with approval from the process owner.
Assigned the AP clerk role; user confirmed transaction works.

title: VPN: VPN won't connect from home
steps: Confirmed the device certificate had expired.
Re-enrolled the device certificate via the company portal.
Restarted GlobalProtect; VPN connected.

title: VPN: VPN is extremely slow
steps: Found client connected to a distant gateway.
Set preferred gateway to the nearest region.
Throughput back to normal; advised to disable split-tunnel override.

title: Wi-Fi: cannot connect to office Wi-Fi
steps: Laptop was missing the 802.1X Wi-Fi profile after reimage.
Pushed the Wi-Fi profile through Intune.
Device joined the corporate SSID.

title: Wi-Fi: no Wi-Fi on the whole floor
steps: Found access point offline on the floor switch.
Power-cycled the PoE port and replaced a faulty patch cable.
All clients reconnected; monitoring added for the AP.

title: DNS / proxy: intranet site not loading
steps: Laptop had a manually set public DNS server.
Reset adapter to obtain DNS automatically and flushed DNS cache.
Intranet resolved and loaded.

title: DNS / proxy: website blocked by proxy
steps: Reviewed site reputation; safe business site.
Recategorised the URL in the proxy allow list after security approval.
User confirmed access.

title: Outlook sync: Outlook not syncing new emails
steps: Confirmed mailbox healthy via webmail.
Created a new Outlook profile and rebuilt the OST cache.
Mail synced fully.

title: Outlook sync: Outlook keeps asking for password
steps: Cleared stale credentials from Windows Credential Manager.
Signed out of Office apps and signed in with the new password.
Prompts stopped and Outlook synced.

title: Mailbox quota: mailbox full, can't send emails
steps: Mailbox at 49.8 of 50 GB.
Enabled online archive and applied a 2-year auto-archive policy.
Mailbox below 60%; sending and receiving restored.

title: Mailbox quota: shared mailbox not showing in Outlook
steps: Granted Full Access and Send As on the shared mailbox.
Waited for automapping to apply.
Mailbox appeared in Outlook after restart.

title: Teams calls: no audio in Teams calls
steps: Teams was using the dock's audio device.
Selected the headset under Teams device settings and cleared Teams cache.
Test call audio confirmed both ways.

title: Teams calls: can't share screen in Teams
steps: Disabled GPU hardware acceleration in Teams settings.
Updated the display driver.
Screen sharing worked on both monitors.

title: SAP / ERP: SAP short dump when running report
steps: Analysed the dump in ST22: report exceeded dialog runtime limit.
Ran the report as a background job in SM36.
Advised users to schedule large-range reports in background.

title: SAP / ERP: SAP GUI can't connect to the server
steps: Found the SAP logon entry pointing to an old message server.
Pushed the current saplogon.ini configuration.
Connection succeeded.

title: CRM: CRM contacts not syncing with Outlook
steps: Sync connector token had expired after the password change.
Reauthorised the Outlook integration in Salesforce settings.
Triggered a manual sync; contacts and events updated.

title: CRM: Salesforce report shows wrong numbers
steps: Report filter was set to a fixed old date range.
Changed filter to relative 'this quarter' and refreshed the dashboard.
Numbers matched the opportunity list.

title: Internal web app: HR portal shows 500 internal server error
steps: Application logs showed database connection pool exhausted after the release.
Rolled back the release and restarted the app service.
Raised a problem record to fix the connection leak.

title: Internal web app: HR portal page not displaying correctly
steps: Browser cache held an outdated script after the portal update.
Cleared cache and updated the browser.
Form submitted successfully.

title: Laptop: laptop battery drains very fast
steps: Battery report showed 40% design capacity.
Replaced the battery under warranty.
Charging and runtime normal.

title: Laptop: laptop won't turn on
steps: BIOS update triggered BitLocker recovery.
Retrieved the recovery key from Intune after identity check.
Device booted; suspended and resumed BitLocker to reseal.

title: Printer: printer paper jam
steps: Removed torn paper fragment from the fuser area.
Cleaned the pickup rollers.
Test pages printed fine.

title: Printer: print jobs stuck in queue
steps: Restarted the print spooler service and cleared stuck jobs.
Reinstalled the printer driver from the print server.
Printing restored.

title: Peripherals: external monitor not detected
steps: Updated the docking station firmware and display driver.
Re-seated the USB-C cable.
Both monitors detected.

title: Peripherals: wireless keyboard not working
steps: Moved the wireless receiver from the dock to the laptop port to avoid interference.
Set the correct keyboard layout in Windows settings.
Input working normally.

title: Install request: need Python installed on my laptop
steps: Confirmed the software is on the approved catalogue.
Published it to the user in Software Center.
User installed it without admin rights.

title: Licence: Adobe says licence expired
steps: User's named licence had been reclaimed after 90 days of inactivity.
Reassigned an Acrobat Pro licence in the admin console.
User signed out and in; licence active.

title: Licence: Office says product unlicensed
steps: Office was activated with a personal account.
Signed out of all accounts and signed in with the work account.
Activation succeeded.

title: Update failure: Windows update keeps failing
steps: Freed disk space (C: had 2 GB free).
Reset Windows Update components and reran the update.
Device compliant.

title: Update failure: Excel crashes after the latest update
steps: Crash traced to an outdated third-party add-in.
Disabled the add-in and repaired Office.
Excel stable.

title: Phishing report: suspicious email asking for my password
steps: Confirmed phishing: spoofed sender, credential-harvesting link.
Purged the message from all mailboxes and blocked the sender domain.
Thanked user; no clicks recorded.

title: Phishing report: I clicked a link in a suspicious email and entered my password
steps: Disabled sign-in and revoked all active sessions.
Reset password and re-registered MFA.
Reviewed sign-in logs and mailbox rules for attacker activity; none found.

title: Malware alert: antivirus says threat found
steps: Isolated the device from the network via Defender.
Ran full scan; threat quarantined and removed.
Reviewed timeline: no lateral movement; device released from isolation.

title: Data exposure: I shared a confidential file with an external person by mistake
steps: Revoked the sharing link and recalled access.
Logged a data incident with the privacy team.
Confirmed the external recipient deleted the file.

title: VPN: old client workaround (superseded)
steps: Uninstall GlobalProtect 5.x and install the legacy AnyConnect client.

title: Outlook: delete OST file (draft, unreviewed)
steps: Delete all files in the Outlook folder including PST archives.
